scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.e2e:db:start: npx --yes supabase@2.119.0 start --workdir e2e -x imgproxy,postgres-meta,supavisor,vector,logflare && npm run e2e:db:schema
scripts.e2e:db:schema: docker exec -i supabase_db_soul-matter-e2e psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < supabase/schema.sql
scripts.e2e:db:reset: npx --yes supabase@2.119.0 db reset --workdir e2e && npm run e2e:db:schema
